name: worktree-control
description: Local control plane that moves development servers between Git worktrees on stable ports
author: pioootrek

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('Refusing npm publish from a checkout: it would pack unverified local dist/out without the fingerprint, clean-tree, checksum and provenance checks. Publish the CI tarball instead; see docs/package-trial.md (Publish a release).'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.build: next build && tsup src/cli/index.ts src/cli/backup-verifier.ts --format esm --platform node --target node22 --clean --out-dir dist/cli && node scripts/build-fingerprint.mjs --write
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:resources
scripts.test:backups: vitest run src/server/modules/backups src/cli/backup-policy-options.test.ts src/server/backup-admin.test.ts src/server/transports/backup-http.test.ts src/server/control-service-storage.test.ts
scripts.test:integration:backup-monitor: node scripts/build-fingerprint.mjs --check && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/backup-monitor.test.ts
scripts.test:integration:remote-backups: node scripts/build-fingerprint.mjs --check && node scripts/require-restic-fixture.mjs && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/remote-backups.test.ts tests/integration/backup-operations.test.ts tests/integration/user-backups.test.ts
scripts.test:integration:remote-rebind: node scripts/build-fingerprint.mjs --check && node scripts/require-restic-fixture.mjs && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/remote-rebind.test.ts
scripts.test:package:remote-rebind: node scripts/build-fingerprint.mjs --check && node scripts/require-restic-fixture.mjs && node scripts/package-smoke.mjs --verification-script scripts/package-remote-rebind.mjs
scripts.test:package:upgrade:driver: node scripts/build-fingerprint.mjs --check && node scripts/require-restic-fixture.mjs && node scripts/package-upgrade-trial.mjs --driver-only
scripts.test:package:upgrade: node scripts/build-fingerprint.mjs --check && node scripts/require-restic-fixture.mjs && node scripts/package-upgrade-trial.mjs
scripts.test:integration:mcp-diagnostics: node scripts/build-fingerprint.mjs --check && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/mcp-diagnostics.test.ts
